rationale: Announcement generation is English-only by construction: src/announcements/humanize.ts hardcodes English CLASSIFY/SYSTEM prompts and an English EMPTY_RELEASE_NOTE, and broadcast.ts fans a single `body` string to every subscriber (broadcast.ts:94-137), so per-user language requires threading locale through humanizeChangelog and per-recipient (or per-locale-grouped) send bodies in BroadcastDeps. Locale resolution already exists via getContextLanguage (src/utils/config-language.ts) over the config context id — DM subscribers derive it from platformInstanceId+platformUserId via toScopedContextId (as announceNewVersion does at src/announcements.ts:115) and groups use their groupId directly; store.ts SubscribedUser/SubscribedGroup shapes likely need to carry that id. The single-draft model (versionAnnouncements.humanizedBody) plus regenerate/broadcast actions in src/debug/settings/admin/release-notes-routes.ts must adapt (e.g. generate locale variants at broadcast time from the reviewed draft). i18n locales gain keys only if scaffolding (section headers, empty note) is localized statically; admin settings UI changes only if preview/response shape changes. No DB migration is strictly required if variants are generated at broadcast time; no chat/task provider interface or credential surface is touched. All work lands in existing announcements/i18n/settings modules — no new top-level subsystem.
